changelog:
x-auto-posting 1.0.0

- Initial release supporting full X (Twitter) auto-posting workflow from keyword-driven topic collection to 24-hour performance tracking.
- Includes browser-based login verification, configuration wizard, and account usage safety checks.
- Automates keyword rotation, topic search, ranking, style extraction, and stores all session/config files.
- Requires user topic confirmation and posting mode via AskUserQuestion tool—no manual chat halt points.
- Ensures all drafts receive user approval before posting or saving, and enforces posting quota/rate-limits by default.
summary: X (Twitter) auto-posting and content operations workflow: keyword-driven topic collection → case reference extraction → user topic confirmation → tweet drafting → publish to X → 24-hour performance tracking.
